d: We are looking for an experienced and technically proficient Assistant Manager – External Audit to support the planning, execution, and delivery of external audit engagements.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in external auditing, with proven experience supervising audit teams, managing multiple engagements, maintaining client relationships, and ensuring audit quality and compliance with professional standards.
q: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field .
Minimum 6.5 years of relevant audit experience , preferably within an external audit or professional services environment.
Professional qualification such as ACCA, CPA, or CA is mandatory.
Strong technical knowledge of external auditing, financial reporting, audit procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Proven experience managing audit engagements, reviewing working papers, and supervising audit teams.
Experience in audit planning, risk assessment, engagement budgeting, and resource management.
Strong client relationship management, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, leadership, and decision-making abilities.
Ability to manage multiple engagements and deliver high-quality work within deadlines.
Proficiency in spoken and written Arabic and English is required.
Familiarity with CaseWare and audit documentation systems would be an advantage.
r: li
Plan, coordinate, and supervise external audit engagements, ensuring timely completion and high-quality deliverables.
li
Develop audit plans, engagement budgets, risk assessments, and appropriate audit procedures.
li
Review audit working papers, supporting evidence, and audit documentation to ensure accuracy and compliance with applicable standards.
li
Supervise multiple audit engagements simultaneously, ensuring effective resource allocation and adherence to deadlines.
li
Review audit findings, identify accounting and audit-related issues, and recommend appropriate solutions.
li
Build and maintain professional relationships with clients, ensuring effective communication and timely resolution of engagement matters.
li
Monitor engagement budgets, staff utilization, billing, and overall engagement efficiency.
li
Lead, guide, and mentor audit team members, providing technical support, performance feedback, and development opportunities.
li

li

li
Coordinate with senior management on engagement progress, client requirements, and key audit matters.
li
Identify opportunities to strengthen client relationships and support the development of the firm's service offerings.

Builds trust and credibility with stakeholders by seeking to understand their service levels expectations and what matters to them individually.

d: Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.

Jumeirah Beach Hotel is Jumeirah’s founding property, characterized by its wave-like design, set along one of Dubai’s most exclusive shorelines. Since its opening in 1997, the resort has become a leading global tourist and family destination. The resort offers a wide range of leisure, wellness, and children’s facilities, complemented by a diverse selection of award-winning dining experiences.
